intent: When a bomb chain knocks players out, each victim bursts in a quick gold sparkle, and a chain that takes down five or more players at once floods every screen, spectators included, with a brief golden flash.
accept: A player knocked out by a chain (killer's chain of 2+ bombs) emits a 12-particle gold burst, 0.6s life, 3px size at their position
A non-chain knockout keeps only the existing effect, no gold sparkle
When 5 or more players are knocked out by the same chain in one snapshot, a full-screen golden flash fades over 0.3s for all viewers
Flash never blocks the view for long and does not appear for smaller chains
